mapper.sql: r.ID, r.TRACKED_LAW_ID, r.PROMULGATION_NO, r.PROMULGATION_DATE, r.ENFORCEMENT_DATE, r.PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_NO, r.PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_DATE, r.PREVIOUS_ENFORCEMENT_DATE, r.DETECTED_AT, r.REVIEW_STATUS, r.REVIEWER, r.REVIEWED_AT, r.NOTE, l.NAME AS TRACKED_LAW_NAME, l.CATEGORY AS TRACKED_LAW_CATEGORY
mapper.insert:
SELECT SEQ_LAW_REVISIONS.NEXTVAL FROM DUAL
INSERT INTO LAW_REVISIONS ( ID, TRACKED_LAW_ID, PROMULGATION_NO, PROMULGATION_DATE, ENFORCEMENT_DATE, PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_NO, PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_DATE, PREVIOUS_ENFORCEMENT_DATE, DETECTED_AT, REVIEW_STATUS, REVIEWER, REVIEWED_AT, NOTE, RAW_DATA ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{trackedLawId}, #{promulgationNo}, #{promulgationDate}, #{enforcementDate}, #{previousPromulgationNo}, #{previousPromulgationDate}, #{previousEnforcementDate}, #{detectedAt}, #{reviewStatus}, #{reviewer}, #{reviewedAt}, #{note, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{rawData, jdbcType=CLOB} )
mapper.select: SELECT ID, TRACKED_LAW_ID, PROMULGATION_NO, PROMULGATION_DATE, ENFORCEMENT_DATE, PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_NO, PREVIOUS_PROMULGATION_DATE, PREVIOUS_ENFORCEMENT_DATE, DETECTED_AT, REVIEW_STATUS, REVIEWER, REVIEWED_AT, NOTE, RAW_DATA FROM LAW_REVISIONS WHERE ID = #{id}
SELECT FROM LAW_REVISIONS r JOIN TRACKED_LAWS l ON l.ID = r.TRACKED_LAW_ID WHERE r.ID = #{id}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT FROM LAW_REVISIONS r JOIN TRACKED_LAWS l ON l.ID = r.TRACKED_LAW_ID WHERE l.IS_ACTIVE = 1 AND r.REVIEW_STATUS IN ('미검토', '검토중') ORDER BY r.DETECTED_AT DESC, r.ID DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit}
SELECT r.REVIEW_STATUS, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM LAW_REVISIONS r JOIN TRACKED_LAWS l ON l.ID = r.TRACKED_LAW_ID WHERE l.IS_ACTIVE = 1 GROUP BY r.REVIEW_STATUS
